title: Great Gift for the Elderly
text:
I bought these, because my Mom lives far away and I thought it would be good to help her with healthy snack choices. She was elated to get these surprises. I don’t think she was familiar with any of the brands, but she’s adventurous and tries new things. So, she’s made sure and told me about each item that she’s tried so far. She’s enjoyed each of them. She’s bragged on these products repeatedly.
So, that she doesn’t have to feel like she has to save the items, I told her that I set up for them to be shipped to her monthly. She was tickled pink!
label: positive
